## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **Date:** 2026-09-14  
  **Source:** [OpenAI — Perplexity improving accuracy with Astra](https://openai.com/index/perplexity-improving-accuracy-with-astra)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI says Perplexity is using GPT-6 Astra in end-to-end operational workflows, including writing communications, changing software, and monitoring production systems, with less frequent human check-ins than earlier models.  
  **Why it matters:** This is a concrete signal that closed frontier models are moving from assistive coding/search into higher-autonomy production operations inside major AI-native companies.

## 5. Regulation & Policy

- **Date:** 2026-09-13  
  **Source:** [AP — Trump downplays need to check AI development](https://apnews.com/article/9df0ebb4c1b0619aa0f88057b5a1092d)  
  **Summary:** AP reports President Trump downplayed calls to slow or constrain AI development, emphasizing U.S. competition with China. The report also notes congressional reluctance to rush into emergency AI restrictions.  
  **Why it matters:** U.S. federal posture appears weighted toward acceleration and geopolitical competition, reducing near-term probability of broad federal constraints on frontier AI development.

- **Date:** 2026-09-12  
  **Source:** [Dario Amodei — We must pace the frontier](https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier)  
  **Summary:** Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for embedded third-party evaluators at frontier labs, coordination among democratic governments on safety standards, and eventual broader international coordination.  
  **Why it matters:** The proposal sharpens the split between lab-led safety pacing and U.S. political pressure to maintain speed against China.
